Are you curious about data, dashboards, and how business decisions are supported by information? We are looking for a Business Intelligence & Data Analytics Intern to join our team and learn how reporting and analytics are used in a real business environment. This is a great opportunity for a student or recent graduate who wants to develop practical skills in data, business systems, and analytics.
 WHAT YOU WILL EXPERIENCE IN THIS POSITION:
Help the team create, maintain, and validate reports and dashboards that support business decision-making.
Support the collection, organization, and analysis of data from various business functions.
Gain hands-on experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Kyubit, SSRS, and Celonis.
Learn how data and analytics support key processes across manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain operations.
Contribute to enhancing reporting quality, improving data accuracy, and ensuring information is accessible and easy to use.
 YOU HAVE:
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
Interest in data, reporting, dashboards, and business systems.
Basic knowledge of SQL, databases, or data visualization tools is a plus, but not required.
Curiosity, attention to detail, and a strong willingness to learn.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and comfort in asking questions and seeking guidance.
Good communication skills and an interest in interacting with different teams and stakeholders.
Motivation to develop analytical skills and gain practical experience in a business environment.
 WE HAVE:
 A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day
nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation. 
Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nVent.com. 
 Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work
We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide 
Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money
